title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah speaks to the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh, Puducherry, Odisha and Chhattisgarh, in the wake of Cyclone Arnab
subtitle:
Union Home Minister assures the states / UT of every assistance to mitigate the hardship of the people in the face of the disaster
NDRF and SDRF teams have sprung into action and are continuing rescue and relief operations on a war footing
IMCTs will soon be sent to assess the impact and further assistance required
Government of India stands with the people with resolute commitment
body_text:
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah has spoken to the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh, Puducherry, Odisha and Chhattisgarh, in the wake of Cyclone Arnab. In a post on X platform, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said, “In the wake of Cyclone Arnab, spoke with the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh, Puducherry, Odisha and Chhattisgarh and assured them of every assistance to mitigate the hardship of the people in the face of the disaster. NDRF and SDRF teams have sprung into action and are continuing rescue and relief operations on a war footing. IMCTs will soon be sent to assess the impact and further assistance required. Government of India stands with the people with resolute commitment.” In the wake of Cyclone Arnab, spoke with the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh, Puducherry, Odisha and Chhattisgarh and assured them of every assistance to mitigate the hardship of the people in the face of the disaster.
